purpose: Teach: 青色/千代田/吉野/鹿島/ミシェル/帯広/朝日新聞社/小学館

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、青色のジャージ着てたな
lines.en: You wore that blue jersey to school, didn't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing challenge. Opening with casual certainty. Leaning in like she's caught him in something small and funny. Quick pace, almost playful accusation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で千代田区行ったろ?桜
lines.en: Didn't you go to Chiyoda on your class trip, Sakura?
lines.style: Turning it back on her with the same light tone. Measured, almost innocent on the surface. Slight smile underneath — he's been waiting to counter. Even delivery, no rush.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で吉野山行ったろ
lines.en: You went to Yoshino with your family, didn't you?
lines.style: Pressing forward now, enjoying the back-and-forth. Sharper certainty this time. Still teasing but with a hint of 'I know you better than you think.' Quick, direct attack.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、鹿島サポーターだったな、桜
lines.en: You're a Kashima supporter, aren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Matching her energy now. Slight shift — he's found something he knows will land. Calm, factual tone. The satisfaction of knowing something unexpected about her. Leveled eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、倫理でミシェル・フーコー習ったろ?
lines.en: You learned about Michel Foucault in ethics class, right?
lines.style: Escalating now — going for the bigger reveals. Slight breathiness on the opening, like she's on a roll. Quick rhythm. Genuine curiosity breaking through the teasing, edge still present.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で帯広行ったろ?桜
lines.en: Didn't you go to Obihiro on your class trip, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady counter. He's not rattled. Simple, matter-of-fact delivery. Like he's been collecting these details all along. Unflinching eye contact in the voice. Slight warmth under the surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、朝日新聞社のインターン行ったな
lines.en: You did that internship at Asahi News, didn't you?
lines.style: Shifting slightly — less teasing now, more genuine acknowledgment of something she respects. Still fast-paced but with a hint of recognition. Slight softening on 'Asahi,' like she's admitting she's impressed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、小学館の漫画雑誌読んでたな、桜
lines.en: You read Shogakukan's manga magazines when you were little, didn't you?
lines.style: Quieter, more intimate. Not teasing anymore — just remembering. Slow, careful delivery. Like he's sharing something he noticed and held onto. Warm undertone. Slight smile at the edges of the words.
